CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 12 / 14

Long-run equilibrium and changes

Long-run equilibrium and firm count長期均衡與企業數

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

In the standard identical-firm, free-entry long-run equilibrium, identify P = MR = MC = minimum ATC, zero economic profit, and production at efficient scale. Determine market quantity and number of firms from demand and output per firm.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

相同企業、自由進出及投入成本不變時，長期 P=MC=最低 ATC，經濟利潤為零。市需求求 Q，再除個別有效率產量得企業數。

For identical firms with free entry and constant input costs, long-run equilibrium has P=MC=min ATC and zero economic profit. Obtain market Q from demand at that price, then divide by efficient-scale q to find N.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TC=50+q²/2 gives ATC=50/q+q/2. Its minimum is at q=10 with ATC=MC=10. Qd=120−P gives Q=110, so N=11.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Long-run P=8, market Q=160, each firm q=10. Number of firms? 企業數？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
